abstract: This study examines the impact of generative AI on creative work by analyzing freelance platform data. The research finds that image generation AI caused a significant reduction in demand for freelance illustrators, with demand falling 21% within 12 months of widespread AI availability, providing empirical evidence of AI's displacement effects on creative labor markets.
keyFindings: Image generation AI reduced demand for freelance illustrators by 21% within 12 months of widespread availability.
methodology: Analysis of freelance platform data tracking demand for illustrators before and after the widespread availability of image generation AI, measuring changes in demand within a 12-month period following AI deployment.
